title: Mastering Project Metrics, KPIs and Dashboards
overview: This course is designed to equip participants with the essential skills to design, implement, and manage project metrics and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). The program focuses on identifying the key drivers behind value-based project metrics and provides the knowledge to design effective project dashboards. Participants will also master the use of Microsoft Project for reporting project performance, enabling them to take timely corrective and preventive actions.
audience: This course is ideal for project managers, members of project offices, project sponsors, functional managers, senior management, and anyone involved in the development and management of project metrics and KPIs. It offers 30 Professional Development Units (PDUs).
methodology: The course employs a combination of interactive techniques, including presentations by both the consultant and participants, group exercises, and case studies. It also features hands-on training using Microsoft Project software.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify the key drivers for improving project metrics.
Define and choose the most relevant project metrics.
Develop and apply effective project KPIs.
Use Microsoft Project to create project KPIs and generate reports.
Design comprehensive project dashboards and traffic light reports.
